description: This file declares functions related to scalar type analysis for ONNX within the Torch JIT compiler, including the main analysis function and a node-specific analysis function.

methods.name: ScalarTypeAnalysisForONNX
methods.description: Performs scalar type analysis for a given Torch JIT graph tailored for ONNX export, considering low precision casting and opset version.

methods.name: ScalarTypeAnalysisNodeForONNX
methods.description: Analyzes a specific node in the JIT graph for ONNX scalar type considerations.
